info.title: Zoho CRM Natural Language Assistant
info.description: Read-only natural-language access to live Zoho CRM data. The backend resolves module, metadata, field names, dates, filters, sorting, aggregation, comparisons, relationships, activities, pagination, and continuation. The user sends only a natural-language CRM question. Copilot Studio must store continuation_token and conversation_id in internal variables and pass them back on pagination follow-ups.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this read-only tool only for live Zoho CRM questions. INITIAL REQUEST: Send the user's complete original CRM question in question, for example {question: 'give me deals created this month'}. Do not send continuation_token for a new query. PAGINATION STATE RULE: continuation_token and conversation_id are opaque internal state values. Do not fill them with generative AI and never ask the user for them. Store every successful response continuation_token in bot.CRMContinuationToken and response conversation_id in bot.CRMConversationId. For pagination follow-ups such as next, next 20, continue, show more, another 20, or yes fetch the next set, call this tool with question set to the user's exact text, continuation_token set from bot.CRMContinuationToken, and conversation_id set from bot.CRMConversationId. After each successful page, replace bot.CRMContinuationToken with the newest response continuation_token and preserve bot.CRMConversationId. For a new CRM query, clear bot.CRMContinuationToken before calling this tool. Never generate a token. Never modify it. Never decode it. Never calculate offsets. Never replace it with a conversation ID. Never call this tool for a pagination follow-up without passing stored pagination state when that state exists. Do not reconstruct filters or create a new CRM query for a pagination continuation. Never emit a Leads field named Converted. Conversion questions must remain natural language. The backend owns pagination, query planning, filters, sorting, offsets, and COQL.

post.description: Pass the user's complete original natural-language CRM request exactly as written in question. For example: 'give me next 20 contacts'. Never map a conversation ID, request ID, activity ID, UUID, module, fields, filters, limit, or offset into question. For pagination follow-ups, pass the exact continuation_token and conversation_id returned by the immediately previous CRM response when available. Never invent, modify, decode, replace, or calculate either value. The backend owns all state, module resolution, query planning, filtering, sorting, and offsets.

403.description: Access denied by the CRM provider.

question.description: Pass the user's complete original natural-language CRM request exactly as written. This must be the user's text, such as 'give me next 20 deals'; never pass a conversation ID, request ID, UUID, module, fields, filters, limit, or offset. Do not rewrite, summarize, translate, interpret, construct structured CRM parameters, calculate pagination, or construct COQL.

continuation_token.description: Internal only. Do not dynamically fill with AI and do not ask the user for this value. For pagination follow-ups, bind this input to bot.CRMContinuationToken, the exact continuation_token returned by the previous CRM response. Leave empty for a new query. Never invent, modify, decode, or calculate it.

conversation_id.description: Internal only. Do not dynamically fill with AI and do not ask the user for this value. Bind this input to bot.CRMConversationId, the exact conversation_id returned by the first successful CRM response. Preserve it unchanged for pagination follow-ups. The continuation_token remains the primary pagination cursor.

success.description: Whether the CRM request completed successfully.

status.description: Backend status string such as ok or error.

request_id.description: Backend request identifier for tracing and diagnostics.

continuation_token.description: Opaque backend-generated token used to continue the current CRM query. Store this value in the internal bot.CRMContinuationToken variable after every successful CRM response. Always replace the old stored token with this newest value. Never display, generate, modify, decode, or calculate this value. An empty string means no further page is available.

conversation_id.description: Backend-generated conversation identifier. Store this value in the internal bot.CRMConversationId variable after the first successful CRM response and send it unchanged on subsequent CRM pagination requests. Never display it or ask the user for it.

question.description: The original natural-language CRM question submitted by the user.

answer.description: Natural-language answer produced from the CRM results.

module.description: Canonical CRM module resolved by the backend.

module_api_name.description: Exact Zoho CRM API module name used by the backend.

request_type.description: Normalized read-only CRM operation type executed by the backend.

count.description: Total number of matching CRM records for this query.

records.description: Returned CRM record payloads for the current page.

limit.description: Maximum number of records requested for this page.

offset.description: Current result offset in the overall CRM result set. This is calculated by the backend. Copilot must never calculate offset values.

returned.description: Number of records returned in this page.

more_records.description: Indicates whether additional CRM records remain after this page.

details.description: Additional structured error context when available.
